claims.evidence: Photos show only the engine on asphalt with a 'T.I AUTOMOBILE' watermark; no origin documents, shipping labels, or Belgium markers are visible.
The engine is static on asphalt; no start, run, or test is shown.
No audio or running condition is captured; knock cannot be detected from still photos.
No odometer, mileage sticker, or readable identification plate showing usage is visible.
Only external appearance is shown; no teardown or internal inspection photos are provided.

risks.risk: Engine does not run or start.
risks.proof: Video of a cold start, idle, and rev, ideally with the engine mounted or on a stand.
Photo of the donor vehicle odometer or import/customs documents confirming low mileage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-mileage or unknown wear.

risks.risk: Missing ancillaries such as ECU, alternator, or gearbox.
risks.proof: Photo showing every included ancillary with part numbers, or a signed inventory list.
risks.if_unproven: priced as engine only, with no ancillaries.

risks.risk: Internal damage or prior teardown (knock, low compression).
risks.proof: Compression or leak-down test results, or borescope/video of internal condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown internal health with knock risk.

risks.risk: Brand and model unreadable, so market value and compatibility are unknown.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the engine nameplate, VIN, or engine code.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unidentified engine with low demand.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine nameplate, VIN, or engine code.
Video of the engine starting from cold and running at idle.
Compression test or leak-down test results.
Photo showing all included ancillaries (ECU, alternator, etc.) if any are included.
Import or donor-vehicle documents to support the 'direct from Belgium' claim.
response.reason: The witness identifies a generic used car engine assembly, but the brand and model that set the Lagos price are unreadable, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a nameplate shot.
